display.purpose: Card titles and the wordmark. Franklin 800, tight.

chrome-label.purpose: Buttons, tray tabs, section headings. Franklin 700 caps, 0.09em tracking.

typed.purpose: Everything the registrar typed: descriptions, keywords, prompts, briefs.

typed-caption.purpose: Mount caption strips, counts, dates, hex labels. Uppercase.

shadows.name: backlight
shadows.purpose: Light bleeding from the table beneath each mount. The only depth device.

shadows.name: backlight-lifted
shadows.purpose: Hover: the slide picked up off the table (pairs with a -3px lift).

shadows.name: safelight-breathe
shadows.purpose: The developing window's breathing amber glow (2.4s loop).

motion.name: ease-mech
motion.purpose: Every state swap. Mechanical, like a carousel advance.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Duration for all state swaps: hovers, tab changes, projection on.

motion.name: develop-in
motion.value: 1.1s ease-mech, filter: brightness/sepia/hue from amber darkness to none
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: a slide resolving out of the darkroom when analysis lands.

components.name: Expose Button
components.description: The primary capture action beside the URL input.
components.css: .ds-btn-expose { background: #d6382c; color: #f4f1ea; border: none; border-radius: 2px; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-expose:hover { background: #b52d22; } .ds-btn-expose:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d6382c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Copy Action
components.description: Full-width copy action on the caption card; hover inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-copy { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 260px; background: #eae6de; color: #2a2630; border: 1.5px solid #2a2630; border-radius: 2px; padding: 11px 14px; font-family: 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-copy:hover { background: #2a2630; color: #eae6de; } .ds-copy-hint { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Tray Tab
components.description: Design-type filter tab; the active tray lifts into the light.
components.css: .ds-tray { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 7px; background: #1c1a1f; color: #a8a49d; border: none; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; padding: 8px 13px; font-family: 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-tray:hover { color: #f4f1ea; } .ds-tray[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #eae6de; color: #2a2630; } .ds-tray-count { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.75; }

components.name: Capture Input
components.description: The registrar's intake: a typed URL well on the charcoal bar.
components.html: <input class="ds-capture" type="text" placeholder="Paste a URL to expose…" />
components.css: .ds-capture { width: 300px; background: #0c0b0d; color: #f4f1ea; border: 1px solid #2e2b33; border-radius: 2px; padding: 9px 12px; font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-capture::placeholder { color: #8f8a84; } .ds-capture:focus { border-color: #d6382c; outline: none; }

components.name: Slide Mount
components.description: The signature component: a bone-mounted slide with typed caption, resting on its backlight.
components.css: .ds-mount { display: block; width: 220px; background: #eae6de; border: none; border-radius: 3px; padding: 7px 7px 0; box-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(255,250,235,0.13); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-mount:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(255,250,235,0.2); } .ds-mount-window { display: block; aspect-ratio: 3/2; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #08090a 0%, #1b1d2b 55%, #5e6ad2 140%); } .ds-mount-caption { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; height: 30px; padding: 0 2px; font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2a2630; } .ds-mount-type { color: #675f58; }

components.name: Palette Chip
components.description: A registrar's color chip: swatch with typed hex.
components.html: #635bff#0a2540
components.css: .ds-chip { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-chip-swatch { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid rgba(42,38,48,0.35); } .ds-chip-hex { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.5625rem; color: #675f58; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Inspo is the art-history slide library, rebuilt as software: a darkened viewing room where every saved screenshot is a mounted 35mm slide glowing on a light table. The images are the only luminous objects in the room; the chrome recedes into the dark, speaking quietly through typed labels and tray tabs. Design types are carousel trays. Opening an item is a projection — the room dims further and the slide fills the wall beside the registrar's typed caption card, which carries the vocabulary: style name, keywords, image prompt, build brief. The register is serious and material, never sterile: bone cardboard mounts, typewriter captions, grease-pencil red, the amber of a darkroom safelight while a fresh save develops. Warmth comes from the materials, not from decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral viewing room; backlit images supply all luminosity
Every image framed in a bone slide mount with a typed caption strip
Strict light-table grid of uniform mount modules — never masonry
One accent: Kodachrome red; safelight amber reserved for in-progress analysis
Typed (typewriter) voice for all metadata; Franklin caps for chrome

rules.name: The Backlight Rule
rules.body: Saved images are the only luminous objects. Chrome never glows, gradients never compete, and nothing on the surface is brighter than a slide.

rules.name: The Safelight Rule
rules.body: Amber means "still developing" and nothing else. Its absence is information.

rules.name: The Registrar's Voice Rule
rules.body: If a human would have typed it on a card — captions, keywords, prompts, briefs — it is set in Courier Prime on a bone surface. Chrome speaks Franklin; records speak typewriter.

rules.name: The Ka-Chunk Rule
rules.body: State changes are instant and mechanical, like a carousel advance: swap, don't slide. 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); the only long animation is the develop-in.

dos: Do frame every image in a Mount Bone frame with a typed caption strip — no naked images on the dark ground.
Do keep state changes instant and mechanical, like a carousel advance: swap, don't slide.
Do show the developing state in Safelight Amber with the caption reading "developing…" — analysis fills the label in when it lands.
Do let density read as abundance; the wall is full, edge to edge.
donts: Don't use masonry columns, hover-zoom cards, or overlay-on-hover metadata — the category rut this world exists to refuse.
Don't add soft drop shadows, glassmorphism, or decorative gradients; depth is tonal and backlit only.
Don't let chrome outglow the slides — no neon accents, no bright fills outside Kodachrome Red's small, intentional uses.
Don't drift into sterile minimalism: the materials (bone, typewriter ink, amber, red) must stay present even in empty states.
